model: Same published PointPillars, only bbox_head trainable
selection: Choose LR by real-validation best 3D AP50 then AP25; ties prefer lower LR. Apply chosen LR to both synthetic arms. Select each checkpoint by the same validation metric. Freeze all before test. Report pretrained, selected and final checkpoints.
other_settings: Reuse previous preprocessing, augmentation, loss, inference and training lists. Feature extractor including BN buffers frozen. AdamW weight decay .01; cosine LR to initial/100; clip10. No test threshold or height changes.
limitations: Retrospective known fold; not fresh blind. Common KITTI pretraining; fine-tuning, not training from scratch. Coverage uses real TRAIN priors.
